page.overview:
Who is Brendan Beiderbecke?

Brendan David Beiderbecke (or Brendan Razzing) is an 11 year-old English jazz pianist whom Lisa Simpson had a crush and relationship with where the two met when the Simpson family went to a STEM conference. While Lisa is walking around, she finds Brendan playing the piano in the main lobby and she soon develops a crush on him.

He is transferred to a school in the West Springfield district, presumably West Springfield Elementary School.
